import sys

MOD = 1000000007
MASK64 = (1 << 64) - 1

def modpow(a, p):
    return pow(a, p, MOD)

def inv(a):
    return modpow(a, MOD - 2)

class mi:
    __slots__ = ('val',)
    def __init__(self, val=0):
        self.val = val % MOD
    def __add__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, mi):
            return mi(self.val + other.val)
        return mi(self.val + other)
    def __radd__(self, other):
        return self.__add__(other)
    def __sub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, mi):
            return mi(self.val - other.val)
        return mi(self.val - other)
    def __rsub__(self, other):
        return mi(other - self.val)
    def __mul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, mi):
            return mi(self.val * other.val)
        return mi(self.val * other)
    def __rmul__(self, other):
        return self.__mul__(other)
    def __truediv__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, mi):
            return self * inv(other.val)
        return self * inv(other)
    def __rtruediv__(self, other):
        return mi(other) / self
    def __neg__(self):
        return mi(-self.val)
    def __repr__(self):
        return str(self.val)
    def __int__(self):
        return self.val

def po(x):
    if x >= 64:
        return 0
    return 1 << x

def shift_left(x, s):
    if s >= 64:
        return 0
    return (x << s) & MASK64

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))

    p = [[mi(0) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            val = int(next(it))
            p[i][j] = mi(val) / mi(100)

    no = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        mask = 0
        for j in range(1 << n):
            if ((j >> i) & 1) == 0:
                mask |= po(j)
        no[i] = mask & MASK64

    m = {1: mi(1)}
    for i in range(n):
        M = {}
        for t_mask, t_prob in m.items():
            for j in range(1 << n):
                res = 0
                prob = mi(1)
                for k in range(n):
                    if (j >> k) & 1:
                        prob *= p[i][k]
                        x = (t_mask & no[k]) & MASK64
                        y = shift_left(x, 1 << k)
                        res |= y
                        res &= MASK64
                    else:
                        prob *= mi(1) - p[i][k]
                key = res
                if key in M:
                    M[key] += t_prob * prob
                else:
                    M[key] = t_prob * prob
        m = M

    final_key = po((1 << n) - 1)
    ans = m.get(final_key, mi(0))
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
